candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out (ReadTimeout, transport error); order in turn times out calling payment, while inventory/redis succeed. The latency originates in the order->payment path, not the gateway itself.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-service telemetry; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable. Order->payment timeout is inferred from traces only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by a ~2s ReadTimeout on the gateway->order call; order's own payment call also times out while inventory/redis succeed. Logs corroborate transport errors on /v1/orders and 502s on /v1/checkout; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms). Bounded to downstream latency in the order->payment path.
